_readme: First read of Los Angeles Harbor College's program maps (S345, SkyLantern). The registry (probe run 37198225537) records the college's mapper page and its link to la-harbor.programmapper.com, not read. A web search (2026-10-08) found the page (/academics/program-mapper): each program shows a 'term-by-term sample map'. Every Program Mapper host read so far answered 403 (lesson 33; West Los Angeles, a sister college, on 2026-10-08), so the mapper gets one load; a refusal is the mapper service's and is not retried another way.

outside_hosts.programmapper.com: The college's own mapper page links la-harbor.programmapper.com as its Program Mapper; one load on the college's behalf, and a refusal is not retried another way.

questions.map_source: Where the college publishes a program's term-by-term map: its own pages, a PDF, or only its Program Mapper.
questions.mapper_open: Whether the college's Program Mapper host answers the reader (one load), and how it lists programs and terms if it does.
